findings.issue: Module-level log() calls datetime.now() directly, which is outside the clock/sleeper injection point required by the strategy contract ('no datetime.now() outside the three hooks'). It has no effect on strategy decisions and is fully overridden by the backtest (strat.log = sim_log in backtest_inside_bar_breakout_scalp.py:51), and the identical pattern exists in every other strategy in this repo, so it is a pre-existing, repo-wide convention rather than a defect introduced here.
findings.fix: Optional cleanup across all strategy files: have log() take a time value as a parameter (or read it from a module-level clock reference) instead of calling datetime.now() directly, to make the contract literally hold; not required before shipping this backtest.
